changes.from: Maker site confirms Beomni humanoid (CES 2022 public reveal of 'Beomni V3', pilots 2022-2024). '1.0' naming comes from press; maker milestone page calls the CES 2022 unit V3. No maker spec sheet found; payload claims (35 lb/arm) only in press.
changes.to: Maker milestone page: 'CES 2022 - Public reveal of Beomni V3', so the CES 2022 unit is V3 ('Beomni 1.0' was press usage). Later generations are Beyond Mark 1 (2023), Beyond Mark 2 (2024) and Beyond Mark 3 (2025). No maker spec sheet found; payload claims (35 lb/arm) only in press.
